setting.floatingsubtitles.statusText: Show status when captions are unavailable
mode.captions_auto: 自动：歌词优先，查无则识别投屏对白
Automatic: lyrics first, projected dialogue as fallback
mode.captions_shared: 沿用 AI 语音的本地设置
module.floatingsubtitles.desc: 将歌词、本地字幕与投屏语音字幕悬浮在三维世界中，支持打字机效果、逐字高亮和自定义位置
Float lyrics, local subtitles, and projected speech captions in the 3D world, with typewriter effects, word highlighting, and custom placement
ui.lyrics.synced: 歌词已同步，正在世界内显示
Lyrics synchronized and displaying in the world
ui.lyrics.speechNeedsCast: 对白字幕需要先选择并开启一个投屏窗口
Dialogue captions require a selected, enabled projection window
ui.lyrics.captionModeHint: 自动模式优先显示同步歌词；无法匹配或没有时间轴时，使用所选投屏的声音生成对白字幕。也可只显示歌词或只识别对白
Automatic mode prefers synchronized lyrics. If no match or timeline is available, it transcribes the selected projection’s audio. Lyrics-only and dialogue-only modes are also available
ui.lyrics.overrideHint: 视频标题和频道作者可能不是标准歌名、歌手；上面的名称可覆盖音乐／投屏元数据，填写实际歌曲信息或导入 LRC，可提高歌词匹配准确度
Video titles and channel authors may differ from the actual song and artist. The fields above override music / projection metadata; enter the song details or import LRC for accurate lyrics
ui.lyrics.speechHint: 对白仅采集所选投屏应用的声音，不使用麦克风、不上传音频；分段识别会有延迟。复用 AI 语音本机引擎／模型配置，无需开启麦克风或填写 AI API Key

Dialogue capture uses only the selected projected app’s audio, not the microphone, and uploads no audio. Segmented recognition introduces delay. It reuses AI voice local engine / model settings; no microphone activation or AI API key is needed
ui.lyrics.metadataHint: 歌曲自动匹配使用 Windows 媒体信息；播放器未提供标准歌曲信息时，可手动填写歌名／歌手、导入字幕，或改用投屏对白识别
Automatic song matching uses Windows media metadata. If standard song information is missing, enter the title / artist, import subtitles, or use projected dialogue recognition
ui.lyrics.networkHint: 歌词查询通过 LRCLIB 现行接口与搜索回退，仅发送歌名、歌手、专辑和时长；可关闭联网。对白识别在本机处理，不上传声音
Lyrics lookup uses LRCLIB’s current API and search fallback, sending only title, artist, album, and duration; online lookup can be disabled. Dialogue recognition runs locally without uploading audio
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.loading: 正在准备本地识别引擎…
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.silent: 当前投屏没有可识别的声音
No recognizable audio in the current projection
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.empty: 这段声音未识别出文字，继续采集
No words recognized in this segment; continuing capture
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.unsupported: 当前系统不支持投屏声音采集
This system does not support projected-app audio capture
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.language: 当前本地引擎不支持所选语言，请更换语言或模型
The local engine does not support this language; choose another language or model
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.dependency: 本地识别依赖未就绪，请检查语音环境配置
Local recognition dependencies are missing; check the voice environment
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.model: 未找到可用的本地识别模型，请在语音设置中选择
No usable local recognition model found; choose one in voice settings
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.failed: 对白识别失败，请检查引擎与模型后重试
Dialogue recognition failed; check the engine and model, then retry
ui.floatingSubtitles.speech.timeout: 本地识别超时，请缩短分段或使用更快的模型
Local recognition timed out; shorten the segment or use a faster model
